searchText: <@!489256758989029405> I've generated http://sprunge.us/BLabrj based on that genesis file Mateusz sent by email, but it's giving me a different genesis hash (0x665da6bac91a9e41049097b0749367ead5fc74a64e22f84b331e6a949198fa4f) than what your node is reporting (0x14a2603062751658538211f50bc7bac02572f16fd3d7e4f29257dac34165a61a), so the eth handshake fails. Any idea what I could be missing? I guess that's because of the contract accounts in your genesis... I'm not sure how to represent those in eip-1085 format. Can you remove them from your genesis? <@!482518216019542016> I am pretty user you can define the initial accounts (for example for mainnet which had all the premine accounts) as for gossiping -> we already have the newblockhashes message so there is no need to duplicate it we can use it for gossipping any node supporting wit, whenever publishing newblockhashes, announces the witness availability for these So, in this way, I feel that publishing NewBlockWitness is just a duplicate. Can you see a scenario where these messages are not identical? Let me know. > <@!482518216019542016> I am pretty user you can define the initial accounts (for example for mainnet which had all the premine accounts) <@!489256758989029405> right, but it'd take some figuring out so if those accounts are not necessary for our initial tests I'd appreciate if we could drop them they are necessary - otherwise we will not be able to create any transactions on the chain there would be no ether in existence except for the miner reward (which is set to zero I believe) We should be able to support them just fine in our EIP-1085 genesis file. If you can generate one account for us in there too we'd appreciate it (or you can just xfer some play-money to an account we control once the chain is up and running) <@!489256758989029405> I can connect to your node now, but it doesn't seem to advertise the wit protocol in the base-proto handshake all these accounts are with simple private keys (from 0 to 10) you can use them freely <@!482518216019542016> I will check the wit config for this node tomorrow morning, maybe wrong version was established (but for now I just wanted to check if we can connect) <@!199273991058227200> would you send me the details for the node - is it configured from source code or Docker? (source code would be preferred so we can keep updating) actually the node is running from the wit branch so strange it did not advertise but I advertise wit0 and you? you wrote wit1 in spec ok, I will check tomorrow I will connect to that node from my local machine and will be ble to start testing wit I will call it a day since I have to prepare for the EIP presentation in 2 hours

excerpts.author: guilhermesalgado9479
excerpts.content: <@!489256758989029405> I've generated http://sprunge.us/BLabrj based on that genesis file Mateusz sent by email, but it's giving me a different genesis hash (0x665da6bac91a9e41049097b0749367ead5fc74a64e22f84b331e6a949198fa4f) than what your node is reporting (0x14a2603062751658538211f50bc7bac02572f16fd3d7e4f29257dac34165a61a), so the eth handshake fails. Any idea what I could be missing?

excerpts.author: guilhermesalgado9479
excerpts.content: I guess that's because of the contract accounts in your genesis... I'm not sure how to represent those in eip-1085 format. Can you remove them from your genesis?

excerpts.author: tkstanczak
excerpts.content: <@!482518216019542016> I am pretty user you can define the initial accounts (for example for mainnet which had all the premine accounts)

excerpts.author: tkstanczak
excerpts.content: as for gossiping -> we already have the newblockhashes message so there is no need to duplicate it

excerpts.author: tkstanczak
excerpts.content: we can use it for gossipping

excerpts.author: tkstanczak
excerpts.content: any node supporting wit, whenever publishing newblockhashes, announces the witness availability for these

excerpts.author: tkstanczak
excerpts.content: So, in this way, I feel that publishing NewBlockWitness is just a duplicate. Can you see a scenario where these messages are not identical? Let me know.

excerpts.content:

excerpts.author: tkstanczak

excerpts.content: We should be able to support them just fine in our EIP-1085 genesis file.  If you can generate one account for us in there too we'd appreciate it (or you can just xfer some play-money to an account we control once the chain is up and running)
